entities.name: Lunderskov-Esbjerg Line
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Lunderskov-Esbjerg line is the railway between Lunderskov and Esbjerg in Southern Jutland. It was opened on 3 October 1874, along with the first part of the Esbjerg–Struer railway line to Varde.
